From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Wells <lauren.wells@harborhealth.com>, Harbor Health Procurement <procurement@harborhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor enrollment & delegated approver — next steps and paperwork

Hi Lauren / Harbor team,

Thanks again for the time today — good conversation on scope and timelines. Quick recap + asks so we can get your commercial path (PO vs card vs marketplace) and vendor setup squared away: 

- Procurement preference: can you confirm whether Harbor will issue a standard PO to Redwood, pay by corporate card, or prefer a marketplace purchase? That will determine the routing.
- Vendor paperwork: most customers need a completed vendor packet + W-9 (US entities) or W-8 (non-US). Can you share Harbor's vendor form (if you have one) or let me know if we should send our packet first?
- Banking for payment: will Harbor accept ACH? If so, who is the delegated approver (name + email) who signs off on vendor setup, and do they require DocuSign or a portal upload?
- Timeline: you mentioned an expected procurement window of ~2 weeks; please confirm if that's still accurate given holidays coming up.

I attached quick post-call notes (postcall-notes.pdf). Once you confirm PO vs card and provide your vendor form (if you have one), we will return our vendor packet and W-9 and provide ACH instructions. I CC'd Marcus (finance) and Jordan (sales ops) to help expedite.

Next steps I propose:
1) You reply with procurement path and delegated approver details
2) If you want us to push our Redwood vendor packet now, we'll attach it to the thread for your finance team to ingest
3) Marcus will confirm our acceptable payment terms and send banking details if Harbor will use ACH

Thanks — talk soon,

--
Mina Haddad
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: postcall-notes.pdf (summary of call, action items)

Mina — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers below and I've attached our internal vendor onboarding form (harbor_vendor_form.pdf).

- Procurement path: Harbor will be issuing a PO for the initial contract. We do not use marketplace purchases for new infra vendors.
- Delegated approver: our Procurement Manager, Lauren Chen (lauren.chen@harborhealth.com), will be the approver for vendor setup and PO issuance. She prefers portal upload but can accept DocuSign if needed.
- Banking: Harbor prefers ACH for vendors; we will need your bank routing + ACH remittance once your packet is returned.
- Timeline: target 2 weeks from receipt of completed packet & W-9 — so if we receive the packet by next Wednesday (11/18), we should have a PO by ~12/02.

I've attached our vendor form for your convenience. If you can return your completed packet plus Redwood's W-9 and banking info, Procurement will start the intake.

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Wells
Sr. Procurement Specialist | Harbor Health
